limitations: One paired game; actor decisions are correlated and are not independent statistical samples.
Changing target inclusion and opponent visibility together does not isolate their separate effects.
Potential exposure is balanced; sender eligibility can still make legal exposures unequal.
The graph mechanically caps recipient opportunities. Reduced transfer concentration does not prove smarter agents or a fair economy.
Cash preference is conditional on offered alternatives in the same bribe-deciding cohort; its uniform reference is descriptive, not an experiment.
Cash-flow attribution is accounting, not a counterfactual replay. Payout is separate from final game cash.
Alias, temperature and seed do not guarantee the same remote model execution; model names and usage are peer reported.
No local paths, endpoint URLs, peer IDs, prompt text, raw model content or credentials are published.
